text: In a Kripke model for IPC, the forcing relation w ⊩ P → Q means:
choices: P is false at w or Q is true at w
for all w' ≥ w, if w' ⊩ P then w' ⊩ Q
P and Q have the same truth value at w
explanation: Kripke: → is forced at w iff preserved at all future worlds — capturing the constructive content.
